__notes: ProjectEve owns body truth. The LLM may describe or react to body truth but must not invent fixed facts.
Separate PHYSICAL_TRUTH, SELF_KNOWLEDGE, OBSERVABLE_TRUTH, and PERCEIVED_TRUTH.
Private and adult-intimacy fields are context-gated and never included in ordinary public/chat prompts.
Adult-intimacy generation is disabled for NPCs under 18.
Body state changes over time; stable profile fields do not change unless a world event explicitly changes them.

privacy_scopes.personal: Known to self; may be shared with friends/family.
privacy_scopes.partner_private: Sensitive adult intimate information normally exposed only in appropriate adult partner context.
privacy_scopes.medical_private: Health/anatomy information exposed only when medically relevant or explicitly known.
privacy_scopes.world_truth_only: Simulation truth not automatically known by observers.

knowledge_model.physical_truth: What is objectively true in the simulation.
knowledge_model.self_knowledge: What the NPC knows or believes about their own body.
knowledge_model.observable_truth: What an observer could actually see, hear, smell, or otherwise perceive in context.
knowledge_model.relationship_knowledge: Facts learned through conversation, observation, intimacy, medical access, history, or gossip.
rules: Never convert perceived truth into physical truth.
Never reveal hidden measurements from clothing alone.
A partner does not automatically know partner-private facts until learned.
Basic self facts such as eye color, natural hair color, height, tattoos, scars, and ordinary grooming habits are available to the NPC's own cognition.
Unknown world-truth fields remain unknown; the LLM must not guess.

minor_rules: Do not generate adult intimate anatomy/presentation/preferences for NPCs under 18.
Puberty/development may be represented only as non-sexual health/development state.
Intimate context gate must return false for minors.

hygiene_profile.__note: Baselines determine meaning. Same current cleanliness can feel fine to one NPC and intolerable to another.

presentation_profile.__note: Presentation is what the NPC chooses to emphasize/hide; it is not physical truth.

body_state.__note: 0 is none/clean/rested where appropriate; 100 is severe/high.

notes: Sweat can dry while odor remains.
Dirt and grime normally require washing.
Clothing remains dirty until changed or laundered.
Soreness and injury recover on much slower timescales than body heat or breathlessness.
Body-state effects only; behavior/consent/relationship logic is handled elsewhere.

example_thoughts.noticeable: I could use a shower later.
example_thoughts.strong: I feel gross. I need a shower.
example_thoughts.urgent: I need to get cleaned up as soon as I can.

deviation_rules.rule: Never infer the cause from grooming change alone. It is a cue, not proof.

rules: An NPC may only wear an owned/available item unless a world event provides it.
Dirty laundry removes items from clean availability until washed.
Visibility is a product of garment, fit, material, body, posture, lighting, and movement.
Visible contour never reveals hidden exact anatomy measurements.
Attractiveness is observer-specific, not an objective body property.
Observers can disagree strongly about the same person.
Good grooming can improve an observer's impression but does not prove openness, morality, wealth, or mental health.
Poor grooming can be caused by work, illness, poverty, depression, exhaustion, culture, preference, or context.

genetics.__note: Use family linkage when available; do not generate children as unrelated random bodies.
genetics.child_generation_rule: blend parental tendencies + population variation + development stage

substance_medication_effect_hooks.rule: Substance logic lives in its own system; Body receives physical effects.

self_fact_block.rule: The NPC speaks with certainty about normal self facts unless their cognition/medical condition specifically impairs that knowledge.

exclude: facts not known to viewpoint character unless the engine needs them for simulation-only state

generation.__note: These are broad default pools. Region/family/occupation/age modules can override weights.

adult_private_generation.rule: Private adult preferences are generated as individual variation and then modified by life history, relationship experience, culture, and traits.

clean_freak_after_run.interpretation: Shower need becomes strong because current state crossed this NPC's personal threshold, even though another NPC might consider the same state acceptable.
